notes:
A straight answer when a trim can't be done.

Typing 'trim it to 0s' used to get 'I didn't catch an edit in that' — Crisp claiming it hadn't understood you, when it had understood exactly and simply can't produce an empty file. It now says so, and offers both readings, since that's usually a slip for one of them: name the length to keep ('trim it to 10s'), or say which part to cut ('cut the first 5 seconds').
